ability.name: Brayblast Trumpet
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**^^Unique Beasts of Chaos Infantry^^** or **^^Cavalry^^** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.

ability.name: Gnarlstaff of Morghur
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Slitherwrack Helm
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.
